storyTagline: A perfect 17-0 season in Atlanta, a fifth straight Falcons title, a new rushing record for Ryland Maxwell and two new Hall of Famers.

stories.headline: Perfect in Atlanta: Falcons Go 17-0 and Win a Fifth Straight Title
stories.dek: Skura's Falcons ran the table in the regular season, beat the Rams and the Packers, then won Super Bowl CXLVI 30-21 at Houston.

stories.headline: Maxwell Breaks His Own Rushing Record and Walks Into the Hall
stories.dek: Ryland Maxwell ran for 2,670 yards, won a third Super Bowl MVP and a seventh ring, and crossed the Hall of Fame bar.

stories.headline: Larienne Throws 56 Touchdowns and Collects a Fourth Ring
stories.dek: Orlando Larienne played every game of the perfect season and now has 198 touchdown passes in 74 career games.

stories.headline: Toohill Takes the MVP as Green Bay Pushes the Champions
stories.dek: Solomon Toohill threw 41 touchdown passes and 1 interception in 20 games, and the Packers reached the last round before the final.

stories.headline: Adam Repeats as Offensive Player of the Year
stories.dek: Apollo Adam caught 97 passes for 1,848 yards and 20 touchdowns; Vyncint Heath scored 22 times despite missing 3 games.

stories.headline: Settle Passes 3,000 Tackles and Enters the Hall of Fame
stories.dek: K'Lavon Settle made 220 tackles in 17 games for the 49ers and pushed his Career Legacy from 7,392 to 7,760.

stories.headline: Houston Hosts the Final and Falls to Skura Again
stories.dek: The Texans lost Super Bowl CXLVI 30-21 to the Falcons, their third defeat in a final against a Skura team.

stories.headline: Otton's Fifth Ring Leads a Roster That Never Lost
stories.dek: Simeon Otton forced 4 fumbles and climbed to an A+ grade, and Chance Woodrum won his eighth ring.

stories.headline: New Cards, Long Careers: Cann, Trask and Biadasz Join the Pool
stories.dek: Eleven players joined the card pool in Y87, among them a former MVP, a former Defensive Player of the Year and a rookie who ran for 29 touchdowns.
